question: The battle of Plassey took place in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1757**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Battle of Plassey was fought on **23 June 1757**.
 
• It was a decisive victory for the British East India Company over the Nawab of Bengal and his French allies.
 
• The battle marked the beginning of British colonial rule in India.
 
• Robert Clive led the British forces, while Siraj ud-Daulah was the Nawab of Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **East India Company:**

 
 
• The British East India Company was a private company granted a trade monopoly with the East Indies by Queen Elizabeth I.
 
• It played a crucial role in the expansion of British influence in India.
 
 
 
• **Siraj ud-Daulah:**
 
 
• Siraj ud-Daulah was the last independent Nawab of Bengal.
 
• He was defeated by the British East India Company in the Battle of Plassey.
 
 
 
• **Robert Clive:**
 
 
• Robert Clive, also known as "Clive of India," was a British officer and soldier who established the military and political supremacy of the East India Company in Bengal.
 
• He played a key role in the victory at the Battle of Plassey.
 
 
 
• **Consequences of the Battle:**
 
 
• The British gained significant control over Bengal, which laid the foundation for British rule in India.
 
• It marked the decline of French influence in India and the rise of British dominance.
